# MFE Orchestrator

> The control plane for your microfrontends

MFE Orchestrator manages the versions, environments, deployments and rollbacks
of a microfrontend architecture, and generates the Module Federation
configuration a host application needs. It runs as a hosted console or
self-hosted.

This file is a pointer. The documentation is served under /documentation and
carries its own llms.txt, which indexes every page.

## Documentation

- [llms.txt](https://mfe-orchestrator.dev/documentation/llms.txt): index of every documentation page, each with a one-line description
- [llms-full.txt](https://mfe-orchestrator.dev/documentation/llms-full.txt): the full markdown of every documentation page, in one file
- [Documentation home](https://mfe-orchestrator.dev/documentation/): the HTML documentation

## Product

- [MFE Orchestrator](https://mfe-orchestrator.dev/): product site
- [Console](https://console.mfe-orchestrator.dev/): the hosted console
- [GitHub](https://github.com/mfe-orchestrator): source, templates and CI integrations
